datasets.title: Population Exposure in Gauteng Metros
datasets.description: This dataset provides the population estimates for Johannesburg, Tshwane, and Ekurhuleni for 2020 and 2030.
datasets.purpose: To assess population exposure to flooding and other hazards in the Kaalspruit River Catchment.
datasets.details: This datasets form part of the initial analysis to understand the exposure of the three Gauteng metros -Johannesburg, Tshwane, and Ekurhuleni - within the Kaalspruit River catchment. This analysis represents the first phase of the 'Resilient Kaalspruit Programme', which aims to assess risk, inform urban resilience and disaster risk strategies, and support evidence-based decision-making for integrated river management.
